title: Reason
specs: Grounded in science with skill acquisition during play
Voted Best Product of the Year (virtual escape rooms)
Recommended minimum age 8 for full participation; younger kids welcome with adult present
No prior knowledge or technology experience required
Reason is wheelchair accessible with ADA bathroom and no crawling or climbing required
Private bookings only, no mixing with strangers
In-person up to 9 players per game; virtual up to 100 players; large events up to 120 in-person or 300 virtual

services.name: Escape Room Party
services.desc: Need a place to cater food or host a reception after the game? We can set up our escape rooms in a classroom or cocktail style for your team to socialize. Food, beverages, plates, cups, napkins, utensils, platters & clean up, not included.

includes: Fully licensed bar for beverages (event space)
gap: Exact duration for most in-person escape rooms not stated
blurb: Guests participate in immersive escape room experiences that involve solving logic-based team challenges grounded in science. Experiences include in-person, virtual, and hybrid escape rooms designed for various group sizes. Additional event spaces are available for parties, corporate events, and offsite meetings.
extraNote: No rescheduling possible for no shows or last minute cancellations · Arrive on time; message if running late · No food served but can coordinate or take delivery
